async function boot() { const cfg = await window.go.main.App.HubConfig(); if (!cfg || !cfg.baseUrl) { throw new Error('Local Sparrow hub did not initialize'); } const rootEl = document.getElementById('sparrow-root'); const rootKeys = (cfg.rootKeys || []).map((hex) => cbor.fromHex(hex)); const hull = createHull({ baseUrl: cfg.baseUrl, hostApi: '3.2.0', rootKeys, shared: { mount: rootEl }, snapshotStore: new IndexedDBSnapshotStore('sparrow-desktop'), authorize: ({ headers }) => { headers.Authorization = 'Bearer ' + cfg.token; }, }); window.__sparrowHull = hull; await hull.start(); // If no signed shell module mounted into #sparrow-root, show a minimal // diagnostic readout proving the Wails WebView <-> local hub <-> Go node pipeline. if (hull.loadedModules().length === 0 && rootEl && rootEl.childElementCount === 0) { const sess = hull.session; const facets = sess?.peerSchema?.facets?.map((f) => f.name) || []; let desktopInfo = ''; if (sess?.peerFacet('desktop')) { try { desktopInfo = await sess.call('desktop', 'info', null); } catch (e) { desktopInfo = String(e); } } const pre = document.createElement('pre'); pre.style.cssText = 'font-family:monospace;padding:16px;white-space:pre-wrap;'; pre.textContent = 'Sparrow Desktop (Wails Empty Hull)\n' + '----------------------------------\n' + 'Status: ' + hull.state.status + ' (' + hull.state.binding + ')\n' + 'Principal: ' + cfg.principal + '\n' + 'Local Hub: ' + cfg.baseUrl + '\n' + 'WT URL: ' + cfg.webtransport + '\n' + 'WS URL: ' + cfg.websocket + '\n' + 'Facets: ' + (facets.join(', ') || '(none)') + '\n' + (desktopInfo ? 'desktop.info(): ' + desktopInfo + '\n' : '') + '\nNo web.modules configured yet — configure SPARROW_DESKTOP_CONFIG with rootKeys & peers/modulesDir to mount your app shell.'; rootEl.appendChild(pre); } } const rootKeys = (cfg.rootKeys || []).map((hex) => cbor.fromHex(hex)); const hull = createHull({ baseUrl: cfg.baseUrl, hostApi: '3.2.0', rootKeys, shared: { mount: document.getElementById('sparrow-root') }, snapshotStore: new IndexedDBSnapshotStore('sparrow-desktop'), authorize: ({ headers }) => { headers.Authorization = 'Bearer ' + cfg.token; }, }); window.__sparrowHull = hull; await hull.start(); } boot().catch((err) => { console.error('Sparrow desktop boot failed:', err); const pre = document.createElement('pre'); pre.style.cssText = 'font-family:monospace;padding:16px;color:#b91c1c;white-space:pre-wrap;'; pre.textContent = String(err) + (err?.stack ? '\n' + err.stack : ''); document.body.appendChild(pre); });
